This role has a strong focus on Nutanix administration, Nutanix AHV, and VMware vSphere-to-Nutanix AHV migrations . The engineer will also support Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, infrastructure monitoring, patching, backup and disaster recovery, networking
eligibility_evidence: Job Title: Nutanix & VMware Infrastructure Engineer Work Location: 100% Onsite (5 days per week) - New York, NY Pay Range: $70-$80/hr D.O.E.
